body: - Fix extensions breaking on Firefox when cookies disabled

- Fix YouTube chapters sometimes not being shown in the timeline 
- Add option to hide creator chapters
- Enable "dynamic extension" url on Chrome for more privacy protection (see https://browserleaks.com/chrome#web-accessible-resources-detection) (thanks @Sbrjt )
- Fix segments not skipping when video is scrolled away

- Add support for new embed player
- Add support for Samsung Internet browser for PC (why is this a thing??)

- Fix options page disappearing if all custom configurations are deleted 
- Improved channel lookups (thanks @mini-bomba )
- Fix button appearing on some YouTube embeds
- Fix chapter text being hidden sometimes

- Add support for Chromium 144
- Fix chapter text rendering

- Add "or" operator to advanced skip options (thanks @mschae23 )
- Make advanced skip options live update all video pages when edited
- Don't auto skip on music videos if non music category disabled 
- Show inspect button when only one time is selected 
- Fix preview bar scaling on new YouTube layout

- Move buttons back to the left on new YouTube layout
- Fix skip profile menu appearing behind your work box

- Fixes for new skip profile UI
- Colour segment selector boxes with the category colour when submitting
- Add segment list default tab config (thanks @FelixFourcolor )
- Add pride theme

- Fix popup when chapters are displayed (thanks @mini-bomba )
- Fix segment hiding/unhiding (thanks @mini-bomba )
- Set default tab to chapters in popup if only chapters available (thanks @FelixFourcolor )
- Fix wrong logic when waiting for image source

**Note: this update requires the addition of the `unlimited_storage` permission to fix an issue on Firefox where the extension would stop working when your computer is close to the storage limit, and for the new channel skip profile feature**

- Added channel skip profiles
  - You can now choose which categories you want to skip for each channel
  - The settings are grouped into "skip profiles" that can be toggled on per channel, current video, current tab, or temporarily for the next hour
  - This replaces the former whitelisting system
- Improve error handling and messages (thanks @mini-bomba )
- Add better UI for nested chapters (thanks @gosha305 )
- Fix thumbnails not displaying full video labels on new YouTube layout
- Fix chapter names on hover appearing in the wrong place

- Split "Preview/Recap/Hook" category into "Preview/Recap" and a new category called "Hook/Greetings"
- Show the category name on hover on new YouTube player layout

- Fix chapter name alignment on new YouTube layout
- Fix skip to highlight button alignment on new layout
- Fix alignment of segment category names on hover
- Add `video.duration` and `video.title` as options to the advanced skip options
- Fix status saying "segments are found" in the popup when categories are disabled
- Add option to hide segment creation buttons in the popup

- Fix upcoming notice being shown for disabled categories
- Fix refresh button in popup not working
- Add guidelines button to popup
- Fix unsubmitted chapters auto skipping
- Add hide segment button to submission menu
- Update help page and improve layout

- Fix skip to highlight button still showing when highlight disabled
- Fix segments appearing in chapter bar even when category disabled
- Fix your work box numbers being too precise
- Fix some channel information requests failing

- Speed up channel information fetches for better whitelisting
- Add advanced skip options
  - https://wiki.sponsor.ajay.app/w/Advanced_Skip_Options
  - This can be used for:
    - Changing skip options depending on where in the video the segment is or how long
    - Changing skip options for certain channels
    - Skipping chapters with certain names
- Fix next chapter hotkey causing multiple chapters to be skipped on Chrome

- Fix next chapter hotkey causing multiple chapters to be skipped
- Fix skip keybind also being used for skip to highlight
- Make popup more accessible
- Fix time without skip shown in YouTube player and in new player design

- Another fix for button placement on new YouTube layout
- Fix behavior for auto skip on music videos when only skipping on music.youtube.com is enabled

- Fix volume controls on new YouTube video layout
- Fix downvoted segments not being hidden locally
- Add a button to loop a chapter (thanks @gosha305 )
- Add option to only auto skip non music category on music.youtube.com (thanks @FlorianZahn )

- Actually remove optional permissions in safari for now due to safari bug
  - Part of the change was missing in the last version, so the bug was still occurring
  - This removes support for Invidious for now until the bug is fixed
  - This may break custom server urls for some people on Safari, but the bug is making the extension unusable on Safari due to permission prompts appearing on many websites when they should not (since they are optional permissions, they should only appear when then extension asks for them)
  - https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=290508

- Remove optional permissions in safari for now due to safari bug
  - This removes support for Invidious for now until the bug is fixed
  - This may break custom server urls for some people on Safari, but the bug is making the extension unusable on Safari due to permission prompts appearing on many websites when they should not (since they are optional permissions, they should only appear when then extension asks for them)
  - https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=290508
- Try to fix NaN showing in skip popup
- Fix server-side add detector when setting time at the end of the video
- Use longer hash prefix when fetching segments to save bandwidth
- Fix dark mode icon on iOS

- Fix skipping on /live/ links which many people are now being redirected too
- Fix skipping accuracy with bluetooth headphones
- Implement support for YouTube TV (tv.youtube.com) (thanks @tech234a )
- Added keybinds for voting on segments (thanks @gosha305 )
- Fix issue with unfinished chapter submissions causing the seek bar to look wrong
- No changes, just a version bump to fix an issue with the Safari release

- Allow importing placeholder chapters without start times
- Fix document script player client fetching
- Fix some errors in the console
- Fix hiding segments not working on videos with YouTube chapters
